$comment: Emit config for the production image. The root tsconfig.json is a CHECKING config
(noEmit, and it includes server/test); this is the only place that writes JavaScript.
rootDir '.' is load-bearing. Server code imports shared by relative path
(../../shared/src/index.js), which gate.sh step 4b enforces over the @r3/shared alias,
so the emitted tree must keep shared/ and server/ as siblings or all 49 of those imports
break at runtime. The entrypoint therefore lands at dist/server/src/index.js.
server/test is excluded: vitest runs the TypeScript directly, and the production image
has no reason to carry tests.
scripts/ IS included, and that is a change: it was in no typecheck program before, so the
root gate never read it. It has to be here because seeding the box is a deploy step and
`tsx` is a devDependency the runtime image does not carry. Its imports are already
../server/src/*.js, so it lands at dist/scripts/qa-world.js and resolves without help.
